protocol.source_label_access: Only fitted source moments at the training controller's actual depths; K5/K6 absent.
protocol.target_label_access: None: target discovery questions are encoded using a discarded placeholder choice index.
protocol.transfer: Use the source moment at the exact admitted condition, else exponential interpolation of admitted source moments by anchor/remaining distance and no-label mean state cosine.
protocol.finite_dose_proxy: Multiply the signed first-order projection by the target no-label clipped/raw RMS ratio; ratio is nonnegative and cannot fix sign errors. No learned label calibration.
audit_hypotheses: Signed projection will outperform unsigned gradient PCA and write magnitude for ranking
The finite-dose law may break sign or ordering even with a positive local projection
At least one scratch controller shows positive utility at an unseen native depth
protocol.target_train_reference: Target-domain labeled Train moment sensitivity, separate from zero-target-label predictions.
